ITA-3.10.1.7 rohiṇī रोहिणी
Sixth layer of skin

ITA-5.63.51 rohiṇī रोहिणी
Diphtheria
A disorder characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: a burning sensation at the base of tongue; large swelling at base of tongue; variable types of pains at base of tongue; life expectancy of three days; obstructing the throat; soft tissue growth obstructing the throat; sprouting muscles at root of tongue in the throat; severe; developing and growing fast; killing the patient quickly.
